nodes.label: Lightmatter
nodes.what: Photonic interconnect company building Passage (3D photonic superchip) and Guide (light engine) for AI scale-up/scale-out.
nodes.why_matters: Anchor. If photonic interconnect becomes central to AI infrastructure, Lightmatter's manufacturing and ecosystem choices define what must scale with it.
nodes.if_scales: Increases demand across silicon photonics foundry capacity, advanced 3D packaging, OSAT partners, and optical qualification for AI clusters.

nodes.label: Passage M1000
nodes.what: 3D photonic superchip with integrated optical circuit switching (OCS) in the interconnect layer; >4,000 mm² interposer class platform.
nodes.why_matters: Flagship scale-up architecture — replaces electrical shoreline with photonic interposer.
nodes.if_scales: Would pull advanced interposer, 3D packaging, and light-engine supply; yield and qualification may become limiting — not observed as binding today.

nodes.label: Passage L200 / L200X
nodes.what: Co-packaged optics interconnect SKUs (32–64 Tbps) with UCIe chiplet integration path.
nodes.why_matters: More deployable near-term CPO entry than M1000; customer chip integration targeted 2026.
nodes.if_scales: Drives CPO packaging lines, chiplet IP integration, and foundry photonics wafer demand at lower complexity than M1000.

nodes.label: Guide VLSP
nodes.what: Very-large-scale photonic light engine paired with Passage platforms.
nodes.why_matters: Optical power and modulation source for Passage — without it, photonic interconnect cannot function at scale.
nodes.if_scales: Increases laser/modulator component demand and optical alignment complexity in package.

nodes.label: 3D photonic interposer
nodes.what: Vertical integration of photonic waveguides, switches, and compute tiles in a single package complex.
nodes.why_matters: Core architectural bet — eliminates shoreline bottleneck via 3D photonics.
nodes.if_scales: Strains interposer substrate supply, bonding equipment, and package test capacity.

nodes.label: Co-packaged optics (CPO) interconnect
nodes.what: Optical I/O integrated at package level rather than pluggable transceiver at rack edge.
nodes.why_matters: Industry transition from electrical to optical at chip/package boundary for AI bandwidth.
nodes.if_scales: Shifts value to packaging OSATs, silicon photonics fabs, and optical engine suppliers.

nodes.label: Silicon photonics fabrication
nodes.what: CMOS-compatible photonic device manufacturing on foundry platforms (e.g. GF Fotonix).
nodes.why_matters: Every Passage photonic layer depends on qualified silicon photonics wafer capacity.
nodes.if_scales: Foundry photonics lines become strategic — limited qualified suppliers globally.

nodes.label: Optical circuit switching (OCS)
nodes.what: On-package optical switching integrated in Passage interconnect layer.
nodes.why_matters: Differentiator vs electrical mesh — enables reconfigurable scale-up topology.
nodes.if_scales: Increases photonic integration complexity and test/qualification burden.

nodes.label: UCIe chiplet interface
nodes.what: Standard die-to-die interface used on L200 for customer accelerator chiplet integration.
nodes.why_matters: Lowers integration friction with existing accelerator chiplet roadmaps.
nodes.if_scales: Pulls chiplet IP ecosystem (Alphawave etc.) and UCIe-qualified packaging flows.

nodes.label: GlobalFoundries Fotonix
nodes.what: Silicon photonics manufacturing platform used by Lightmatter.
nodes.why_matters: Named foundry partner for photonic wafer production in public disclosures.
nodes.if_scales: A Passage ramp would increase dependence on disclosed GF Fotonix capacity; alternate foundry paths not established in public sources.

nodes.label: Amkor (3D photonics packaging)
nodes.what: OSAT partner targeting largest 3D photonics package complex with Lightmatter.
nodes.why_matters: Disclosed packaging partner for M1000-class 3D photonics — partnership exists; current production constraint not publicly evidenced.
nodes.if_scales: If Passage volume grows, Amkor advanced packaging throughput and yield could become limiting — inference, not observed bottleneck today.

nodes.label: ASE Group
nodes.what: Manufacturing/OSAT partner listed in Lightmatter disclosures.
nodes.why_matters: Additional packaging capacity path — diversifies OSAT dependence.
nodes.if_scales: Expands qualified packaging throughput if ramp succeeds.

nodes.label: Alphawave Semi (chiplet IP)
nodes.what: Provides royalty-free chiplet IP for L200 customer integration.
nodes.why_matters: Enables accelerator vendors to attach chiplets to L200 without full custom PHY redesign.
nodes.if_scales: Chiplet IP licensors gain attach rate if L200 becomes standard CPO integration path.

nodes.label: Advanced interposer capacity
nodes.what: Large-area interposer substrate and fabrication capacity for M1000-class packages.
nodes.why_matters: M1000 >4,000 mm² interposer implies yield/scaling complexity — shared bottleneck with advanced AI packaging.
nodes.if_scales: Competes with CoWoS/HBM packaging for interposer substrate and OSAT attention.

nodes.label: Optical packaging yield
nodes.what: Yield risk from aligning lasers, waveguides, and electrical tiles in 3D package.
nodes.why_matters: Optical misalignment destroys bandwidth advantage — yield gates economics.
nodes.if_scales: Drives inspection/metrology and rework capacity demand.

nodes.label: Photonic interconnect qualification
nodes.what: Multi-year customer qualification for production AI deployments.
nodes.why_matters: L200 production systems expected 2027 — qualification timeline gates revenue.
nodes.if_scales: Extends sales cycle; favors vendors with existing hyperscaler relationships.

nodes.label: AI scale-out clusters
nodes.what: Large GPU/ASIC clusters requiring high-bandwidth node-to-node interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Primary demand driver — photonic interconnect targets bandwidth walls in scale-out.
nodes.if_scales: If photonics wins, rack optical connectivity and cluster topology design shift.

nodes.label: AI accelerator chiplets
nodes.what: Disaggregated compute tiles integrated via advanced packaging and die-to-die links.
nodes.why_matters: L200 UCIe path assumes customers bring accelerator chiplets to CPO package.
nodes.if_scales: Chiplet vendors and packaging houses see higher attach if CPO becomes default.

nodes.label: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem
nodes.what: NVIDIA interconnect ecosystem; Lightmatter participation reported.
nodes.why_matters: Potential route to hyperscaler-scale deployment — ecosystem fit matters more than raw Tbps.
nodes.if_scales: If integrated, NVIDIA supply chain and qualification paths amplify Lightmatter reach. Not expanded into full NVIDIA ecosystem here.

nodes.label: Hyperscaler AI infrastructure
nodes.what: Cloud and training infrastructure buyers (undisclosed customers).
nodes.why_matters: Ultimate demand sink — but Lightmatter has not publicly named design wins.
nodes.if_scales: UNKNOWN customer pull — inference only until disclosed wins.

nodes.label: Optical rack / fiber connectivity
nodes.what: Fiber plant and optical links connecting packaged photonic nodes in rack and row.
nodes.why_matters: Package-level CPO still interfaces with system-level optical plant.
nodes.if_scales: Structural second-order link if photonic nodes deploy — no quantified fiber-demand evidence in this map.

nodes.label: Ayar Labs
nodes.what: Competing photonic interconnect vendor (in-package optical I/O).
nodes.why_matters: Sets competitive benchmark for qualification, partnerships, and hyperscaler traction.
nodes.if_scales: Market may support multiple winners but splits OSAT/foundry attention.

nodes.label: M1000 EVK validation
nodes.what: Evaluation kit deployed in Lightmatter validation data center.
nodes.why_matters: Evidence of internal qualification progress — not yet production customer deployment.
nodes.if_scales: Precedes customer qual; reduces technical risk but not commercial risk.

nodes.label: Electrical SerDes / copper
nodes.what: Incumbent high-speed electrical interconnect at package and rack level.
nodes.why_matters: Substitution path — if electrical bandwidth keeps pace, photonic urgency drops.
nodes.if_scales: Competitive pressure on photonic cost and qualification timeline.

nodes.label: AI bandwidth wall
nodes.what: Growing bits-per-second demand between accelerators exceeding practical electrical I/O.
nodes.why_matters: Demand driver for entire map — without bandwidth pressure, photonic interconnect stays niche.
nodes.if_scales: Accelerates CPO adoption across all branches of this map.
